verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Grafana publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at grafana.com/api/openapi.json, which is a documented public API an agent can drive. The official MCP server and the CLI for administrative tasks reinforce programmatic access, though they are separate interfaces from the API itself. Missing for 10: first-party prose docs describing the HTTP API's endpoints, auth and coverage (e.g. dashboards and alerting via API), and independent or hands-on corroboration of driving Grafana through the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://grafana.com/api/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
You can authenticate, manage multiple environments, and perform administrative tasks from the terminal.
